sections.value:
**Combined #200, #201 and #203 deployment reading complete**, as authorized by pm-001, at main `7f6ed760ed98b2fda2e6095750a6e8f620132f8f`. This is **not an isolated #200 window**: its earlier PID99236 was gone before measurement. #200 merge `3e31243799c2cde48a8cb9ba87d6a203d8ad0ef4` is an ancestor of this deployed head.

Healthy **PID94129**, process start **09 Nov 14:54:03 +10:00**, remained the same incarnation; bracketing pings report embedded commit `7f6ed760ed`.

| Reading, 09 Nov +10:00 | Result |
|---|---|
| Daemon minute | **15:03:09.824983 to 15:04:09.825780**, **60.000626 monotonic seconds** |
| Recorded launches | **312 to 329: +17**, **0.2833/s**; **+16 ps.registration-native-process**, **+1 sh.background-job**, all other sites flat |
| Registrations | **96 to 104: +8**, all `lease-retry.pane.holder-current`; registration ps **192 to 208: +16** |
| Whole-daemon CPU | Cumulative **103.28 to 114.59 seconds**: **11.31 CPU seconds**, **18.85% of one CPU** |
| RSS | **215,392 to 179,856 KiB**, **210.344 to 175.641 MiB**, **-35,536 KiB** |
| Separate 20-second machine sample | **119.1 launches/s estimate**, **106.1/s sampled**; **66.0/s gone**, **39.8/s other**, **0.2/s recognized direct daemon children** |

The machine sample overlapped the minute and made **230,733 polls**; it costs CPU and attribution is a lower bound. The recognized direct-child label was `pij-rs`; that label alone does not establish its operation. Each minute snapshot's site totals reconcile.

The extra registration activity is positively visible: two seats each add four holder-current retries and eight ps launches. This prices observed retry work, not Claude heal adoption. No closed-Claude conversation or installed-script execution was generated to prove the status-line fix here. The RSS fall is not an isolated product saving.

The later ping total **346** is outside the minute and is not its delta. Subsequent/combined code, traffic and shared-host load prevent causal attribution to one PR. No bounce, local build/test, synthetic traffic or closure/revive probe was performed.

The requested #200 reading debt is closed by this explicitly combined window. Raw receipts: `pr200-201-203-before-ping.json`, `pr200-201-203-window.json`, `pr200-201-203-machine.json`, `pr200-201-203-machine-times.txt`, `pr200-201-203-after-ping.json`.
